sources.title: SmilyAI — Independent AI Research Lab Free AI + 3D prints
sources.snippet: Independent research, real results. SmilyAI is an indie AI research lab focused on building capable, efficient models without the overhead of big tech. We believe the most meaningful progress happens when small teams move fast and stay focused. Our work spans large language models, video generation, and multimodal systems — all built with an open-first philosophy.
